results.title: Cape Coral Mayor John Gunter skips council meeting day after losing in primary election
results.description: Cape Coral Mayor John Gunter missed the city council meeting following his primary election defeat, leaving voters to choose between Lisa Cohen Adkinson and Rick Erickson in November.
